state.intent: Add a small, honest Bluesky market-discussion language-cue sample to the existing visual morning product without reintroducing the clutter the owner disliked.
catalog: Neutral horizontal bars and semantic values
Current-only external displays already live in Price chart & technicals

tokens.palette: existing charcoal/sage dark and warm-neutral light variables --panel --text --text-secondary --text-muted --accent --border
tokens.rules: 390px responsive,44px controls,keyboard-native details,no color-only semantics,reduced motion

evidence.source: Free no-auth Bluesky Jetstream v2; short bounded capture of English-tagged originals containing exact supported cashtags/index names or defined broad US-market phrases. One most recent qualifying record per distinct account per instrument. Edits/deletes/account removals processed during capture; no text or identifiers saved.
evidence.data: Per instrument distinct-account count and4simple language cue buckets:upward,downward,mixed,unclassified. Distributions suppressed below10accounts. First2min narrow capture found0matches;10min capture underway, no result assumed.
evidence.limitations: Not X/Instagram/all Bluesky/representative retail. Word cues are not inferred emotions or validated sentiment, unclassified is not neutral. Short window not full day. No consensus vote/model training. Raw data never public. Owner report email explicitly authorized support@thedailyconsensus.com.

constraints: Keep collapsed by default, no new hero/top-levelcard
Show actual start/endwindow,samplecount and method prominently
Each instrument uses its own subset; do not relabel pooledMarket counts underSPY/QQQ/IWM/DIA/TLT
No current sample inside a selected historic edition
Source display separate from saved scoring, no fabricated full-platform feeling
Expose honest insufficient/expired status without zero tone

placement.instructions: Choose a calm location that keeps this current-only community sample distinct from official news and saved scores.

criteria.own_disclosure: A fourth collapsed numbered research section after price/technicals, titled Community discussion. It holds the bounded sample and later optional hosted crowd context.
criteria.news_subpanel: A compact subpanel at the end of existing News & company earnings, explicitly labelled current-only sample.
criteria.within_price: A subpanel in Price chart & technicals as another current-only display.

visual.instructions: Choose presentation for4language-cue counts with n>=10; preserve unclassified as separate and show count, not a calibrated sentiment score.

criteria.horizontal_lanes: Four compact neutral horizontal tracks with direct category/count/percentage labels, minimum threshold notice when sparse.
criteria.stacked_bar: A single4segment horizontal distribution with direct legend labels, counts/percentages and accessible description.
criteria.numbers_only: Four simple count tiles with percentages, without chart.

method.instructions: Choose concise disclosure for this limited sample.

criteria.essential_inline: Window,count,word-cue qualifier and distinct platform inline; exactfilters,expiry/deletionmethod andsource/reportlinks in native details.
criteria.all_inline: Every sampling rule,limitation andsource/reportlink always visible below chart.
criteria.source_drawer: Essential labels inline,allsource/method details in a modal drawer.
